integrity: The proof reduces codes to five projective multiplicities, derives the Hermitian Gram rank from parity, applies the exact A5 cycle index, and proves all-length strict inequalities with an exact period-60 rational-function certificate independently replayed by a standard-library verifier.
scientific_limitations: Complete for monomial-equivalence classes of quaternary dimension-two codes only; semilinear equivalence is not counted, zero coordinates are allowed, and no higher-dimensional monotonicity theorem is claimed.
title: Exact all-length enumeration of inequivalent quaternary \([n,2]_4\) codes by Hermitian hull dimension
